entries.title: Job 29:2
segments:
In months past; in the time of his prosperity. 
 
Prosperity is the gift of God.  He grants as much of it to his people, and continues it as long, as he sees best; but no one should feel that it will certainly be continued to the end of life, or forget that it may soon and suddenly be taken away.

entries.title: Job 29:6
segments: Butter, and--oil; the symbols of great prosperity and abundance.

entries.title: Job 29:7
segments: I prepared my seat; as a magistrate or judge.

entries.title: Job 29:8
segments: Stood up; as a token of respect.

entries.title: Job 29:10
segments: And their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth; they were overawed and held their peace.

entries.title: Job 29:11
segments: Gave witness to me; to his integrity and usefulness.

entries.title: Job 29:14
segments: It clothed me; uprightness was that by which he was known.  It was his covering and ornament.

entries.title: Job 29:16
segments: I searched out; he inquired into and examined with impartiality the cause of the stranger, as well as that of his acquaintance.

entries.title: Job 29:17
segments: Brake the jaws; overcame the oppressors, and delivered the oppressed.

entries.title: Job 29:18
segments:
Die in my nest; not meet with reverses, but live long, and go to the grave in peace. 
 
Confidence in the continuance of peace and prosperity is dangerous, and often followed by disappointment and sorrow.  If the Lord will, we shall live; and we shall be in this condition or that, in prosperity or adversity, as seemeth good in his sight.

entries.title: Job 29:19
segments: My root was spread out; he flourished like a tree by a fountain of water.

entries.title: Job 29:20
segments: My bow was renewed; the bow is an emblem of strength, and a means of defence.  The meaning is, he was kept constantly strong.

entries.title: Job 29:22
segments: They spake not again; men were satisfied with his decisions.

entries.title: Job 29:23
segments: They waited for me; to speak and settle their difficulties.

entries.title: Job 29:24
segments:
Laughed; smiled kindly. 
 
  Believed it not; for joy.
